Research direction · 01

Learning Theory: Trustworthy AI Foundations

We study why adversarially trained models succeed on some examples and fail on others. Our work spans generalisation, representation learning, and training methods that account for the geometry and distribution of the data.

Adversarial learningRobust generalisationRepresentation theoryLearning dynamics

Four research directions

  1. 01Learning Theory
  2. 02AI Governance
  3. 03Model Security
  4. 04Embodied Intelligence

Research focus

What we study.

01

Robust generalisation

Examine when adversarial training generalises, including the accuracy–robustness trade-off and the role of sample geometry.

02

Reliable representations

Analyse how individual training examples affect contrastive representations and where misalignment arises.

03

Robust training methods

Use distributional discrepancy, pixel reweighting, and coreset selection to improve or simplify robust training.
